profile.visual_desc: Muscular soldier in blue trousers and a brown tunic. Features a full-head grey mechanical helmet with external wiring and a massive, shoulder-mounted grey launcher.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Profile of a grey robotic helmet with a prominent blue circular lens and a smaller red sensor. Tufts of red hair visible from the rear.
profile.weapon_desc: Heavy grey shoulder-mounted energy cannon supported by both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Stands in a wide isometric stance facing down-right, bracing the heavy launcher on the right shoulder.
profile.step2_windup: Tenses posture while maintaining aim; the launcher barrel stabilizes for discharge.
profile.step3_impact: Fires a bright blue spherical energy blast from the muzzle directed toward the bottom-right.
profile.step4_finish: Launcher barrel kicks back slightly from recoil; blue energy trail dissipates as character resets stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The circular blue energy discharge in Frame 4 originates exactly at the cannon's muzzle, aligning with the downward-right firing trajectory.

evaluation.diagnosis: The 10-frame sequence is a high-quality expansion of the original 6-frame reference. The wind-up frames (F0-F4) include a torso rotation that adds believable anticipation, and the muzzle flash VFX in F5-F7 aligns perfectly with the cannon's muzzle, maintaining the downward-right trajectory without any body flipping or anatomical errors.
